nom: Mario Badescu Facial Spray with Aloe

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the mist absorbs quickly and helps keep shine down through the day without feeling greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with flaking, cracking skin in winter, describe it as a quick moisture pick-me-up, though one reviewer's acne-prone skin felt drier after use and needed a separate moisturizer.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination acne-prone skin say it keeps their face looking fresh and evens out skin tone without disrupting makeup.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who react to most facial products, generally report no stinging, irritation, or breakouts, though one reviewer's skin developed small irritation bumps that she traced to the rose water formula.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including one with severe winter dryness and flaking, describe the mist as an effective quick hydration boost that leaves skin soft and dewy; several note the refreshed feeling fades within minutes, and one reviewer with acne-prone skin found her face felt drier after use and needed a regular moisturizer on top.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say the mist helps even out redness and skin tone with regular use, though one had only tried it twice and couldn't yet judge the effect on her redness.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers with acne scars and dark spots report visible fading and a more even complexion after weeks of regular use, alongside fewer and faster-clearing breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including several who are acne-prone or sensitive, report no breakouts and some describe clearer skin or faster-healing acne with regular use; however, some report the current formula did not help their acne, one broke out slightly more after starting it, and another experienced burning and breakouts after a reformulation that other reviewers also mention.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the mist absorbs without leaving a greasy or oily film and helps keep shine down through the day; no reviewer reported it making their skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Fine, lightweight mist that isn't sticky
Ingredient list changed to include dyes and propylene glycol
Bottles frequently leak or arrive underfilled
Light rose scent most reviewers enjoy

extraits.texte: I bought this product hoping it would help my acne, set my make up, and keep my skin feeling moisturized. I've sprayed this product on my face morning and night after washing my face for the past 2 weeks and no signs of helping my acne. When it comes to setting my make up it did an alright job but if you spray too much your make up wipes right off. Now this gets me upset, this product makes my skin feel sooo dry! I have to put on regular moisturizer after using this product because of that. I've seen in the reviews that Mario Badescu changed the ingredients, they need to go back! I give this product 2 stars because it does smell very good but other than that this product isn't for my skin.

I had purchased this product earlier this year and LOVED it. Great smell, didn’t irritate my face, it was amazing. I purchased it again recently and the smell is slightly different, more like a perfume than before and it burns my face and has caused irritation and breakouts. Not sure if the formula changed or if the product is no longer legit. Wish it hadn’t changed because now I have to find something new!

extraits.titre: This offers a lovely dose of refreshing hydration, but the spray bottle function is dreadful.
extraits.texte: The product itself is a win for me. I'm in my 40's with combination, acne-prone skin, so I generally avoid heavy and/or cream facial moisturizers. I do, however, need some light hydration, especially on makeup days (before, during, & after application). This facial spray offers a lovely hydrating, refreshing facial pick-me-up any time of the day. It is definitely fragrant, so if someone avoids that in their facial products, this isn't for them, but I actually love the smell - a light rose scent (I always love anything rose-scented). The scent doesn't last long - I can't notice it after it dries or within a few minutes. While I don't think this is revolutionary or liable to change my skin in some big way, for the price, I'm happy with the quality and performance. One caveat that caused me to deduct a star - the spray function of the bottle itself is dreadful. It's the lousy spray quality I'd expect from something picked up at the dollar store. As one of the makeup artists I follow online would say, "She spits." That's the best way to describe this spray function - a random spitting sensation. In fact, the sprayer alone makes me hesitant to use this on top of makeup because the squirting is so spotty and heavy, I fear it might disrupt my makeup. Thankfully, I have a different empty facial spray mister bottle that works much better that I plan to transfer this product into. Dry skin? Rosewater spray. Frizzy hair? Rosewater spray. Boyfriend acting up? Rosewater spray. Let me start by saying I have dryyyyy skin. I have the kind of skin that flakes and bleeds, especially in the winter. I try to look for natural products the best I can, but not to the point where I'm like a hippie or anything so please don't throw rocks at me if my products aren't straight from the earth. :( I moisturize every night with a homemade whipped shea butter and almond oil lotion. It's very moisturizing but obviously not for the daytime because it's on the heavier side (I like my face to feel like it's getting a treatment overnight!). During the day, I use Cetaphil's face lotion with SPF. It's moisturizing, but of course it's not going to be like a night cream! So if you ever need a pick me up... MARIO BADEACU ROSEWATER SPRAY TO THE RESCUE! It has aloe in it and smells like roses. I just give my face a spritz and I instantly feel my skin perk up. It's not greasy, just moisturizing. I've gotten so many of my friends and family obsessed with this stuff. I have a bottle on my bathroom counter and one in my purse for on the go. I've even used it to spray on my hair if I'm out in public and my hair is a frizzy mess! Don't believe the hype? My husband keeps a bottle in his toiletry bag. Yes, he's in the army. :)

extraits.titre: Surprisingly Refreshing – Even if It Feels Too Good to Be True!
extraits.texte: I’ve seen this product around for years and always thought, “Is this just a gimmick?” But lately, I’ve been waking up with an oily face and wanted an easy, quick moisturizer I could spray on in the morning to get me out the door. And you know what? This really hits the mark. A few sprays, and I’m good to go. It soaks in fast, keeps my skin feeling fresh, and helps keep the oil at bay throughout the day. Honestly, I even catch myself enjoying the little morning “refresher.” I’d recommend it, even if you think it might be a placebo effect. Maybe it is, but if so, it’s a trick I don’t mind falling for!

I have searched a long time for a product like this. I have extremely sensitive skin. This is kind and gentle enough, I can use it 2x a day! I have never been able to use any kind of face product more than once a day or a few time a week. I spray this on a cotton round and wipe my face with it in the morning. At night, I spray directly onto my face after washing. I have noticed my skin is significantly healthier since using this!

Smells great! I have suffered from acne for several years now, adult acne. After about a week the cystic acne one the side of my face cleared up! All the acne scars on my face are healing too. I still have breakouts but they clear up so much faster now. Buy it if you have dark spots or acne scars!
